Houston claims Sibo Chen was "clearly lacking information but yet speaking as an expert." Chen suggested the email was meant to intimidate him.

canada.title: Province defends N.B. Power selling surplus electricity at market rates outside New Brunswick

canada.title: Community centres stretched thin at the front lines of a changing world, but not giving up

canada.title: 'Horror fanatic’ gets into Halloween spirit, raising donations with haunted house

canada.title: More Canadian provinces are ending time changes. What does it mean for your health?

canada.title: He tried to get into Montreal's kosher market. It led to a battle over alleged meat monopoly
canada.summary: Mendy Boyarsky alleges the Jewish Community Council of Montreal (JCC) is using its market dominance to limit competition to the kosher meat market through its certifier, Montreal Kosher, known as MK Kosher. He asked the federal Competition Tribunal to step in. The JCC, which runs MK Kosher, denies the allegations.

canada.title: As military housing expands in Shannon, Que., mayor calls for urgent action on traffic

canada.title: 'It feels fantastic,' Scott Gillingham says after winning another term as Winnipeg mayor
canada.summary: After winning his second consecutive term as Winnipeg mayor, Scott Gillingham says the city's best days are still to come. He had 39.8 per cent of the ballots cast, with all polls reporting just before 10 p.m. Wednesday.

canada.title: 'Time for change': Lora Meseman takes Transcona seat from Russ Wyatt, incumbent facing sex assault charges
